top_signals.title: Fed’s Path to a Repo-Based Framework Faces a Familiar Roadblock
top_signals.summary: As Federal Reserve officials ponder ways to shrink their holdings and keep markets flush with cash from lending operations, they face a challenge years in the making: Overcoming the stigma of borrowing from the central bank.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: VF Corp CEO on 2Q, Vans Recovery and Affordable Luxury
top_signals.summary: Bracken Darrell, CEO of VF Corp says sales were down 9% in the first half of the year but are expected to decline 2% or less in the second half, putting the brand on track to turn positive “at some point soon.” He said VF is investing in innovation across iconic products, new silhouettes and styles, and pointed to rising search interest as evidence of brand momentum. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
